explanation: Generated an EXCLURAD Eta input for W=1.7 GeV, cos(theta*)=0, and phi*=90 degrees. EXCLURAD expects the positive convention Q^2=-q^2; supplying -0.5 directly would make its logarithms and square-root kinematics invalid, so the requested spacelike invariant q^2=-0.5 GeV^2 was corrected to input Q^2=+0.5 GeV^2. The repository's Eta defaults were retained (EtaMAID model, 6.53 GeV electron beam, full O(alpha) correction, vcut=0.166 GeV^2). The code could not be run in this environment because no compiler or shell is available.
